offering_description.value: Designs, engineers, manufactures, certifies and supports avionics such as flight displays, autopilots, flight computers and air data systems. It sells retrofit and forward-fit solutions to aircraft operators, MROs and OEMs, with all products made in-house in Exton, Pennsylvania.

quotes.quote: Innovative Aerosystems designs, engineers, manufactures, certifies, and supports advanced avionics solutions for commercial, military, business, and general aviation aircraft worldwide. From integrated flight decks and autopilots to autothrottles, flight management systems, mission computers, air data systems, displays, engine instrumentation, and navigation technologies, our scalable solutions are engineered to meet the unique requirements of every platform.

At Innovative Aerosystems, we deliver custom avionics systems designed for your specific aircraft requirements—whether you’re upgrading a legacy platform or outfitting new production. From our FAA-certified flat panel flight decks to our award-winning ThrustSense® Autothrottle, our systems are engineered for performance, precision, and agility—delivering modern solutions for today’s demanding flight environments. Every product we design is engineered, certified, and manufactured at our in-house facility in Exton, Pennsylvania.

primary_products.value: flat panel flight displays; flight management systems; autothrottles; air data computers; autopilots

quotes.quote: Cockpit/IP® Flat Panel Display Systems – FAA/EASA certified for B757/B767/737 and other platforms. Upgrade your cockpit with minimal wiring changes and transformative capability.
ThrustSense® Autothrottle – Full-regime autothrottle with FADEC-like protection for King Air and PC-12 aircraft. Flying Magazine’s Editors’ Choice Award winner.

primary_services.value: engineering services; certification support; lifecycle support

quotes.quote: Avionics, flat panel displays, flight computers, and engineering for aerospace—quality, support, and in-house manufacturing.

As one of the few U.S.-based avionics manufacturers with vertically integrated engineering and production, we control every stage of development—from concept and certification to manufacturing and lifecycle support. This enables us to deliver tailored, mission-ready solutions with the quality, reliability, and responsiveness our customers depend on. Whether modernizing legacy aircraft or developing next-generation capabilities, Innovative Aerosystems provides the expertise, flexibility, and innovation to keep fleets flying safely, efficiently, and ready for the future.

customer_segment.value: B2B: aircraft operators, MROs, OEMs, fleet operators, business and commercial aircraft owners; B2G: US Department of Defense and military aircraft programs

quotes.quote: Hundreds of aircraft are flying Innovative Aerosystems avionics, we specialize in retrofitting commercial, business, and military aircraft with advanced, value-driven solutions that reduce downtime and improve situational awareness. Our agile engineering team works directly with operators, MROs, and OEMs to deliver tailored solutions that meet certification standards while maintaining installation simplicity.

From Pilatus to Boeing, from DHL to the US Department of Defense, Innovative Aerosystems products fly on some of the most iconic platforms in the skies. We take pride in American manufacturing, rigorous AS9100D quality standards, and support that doesn’t end after installation.
